title: layr change list --json
description: The logical changes of the project, in change id order (the order they were made). A change is a sequence of versions (states) with one change id, for example a state and its amended forms. Without a flag the list has the changes that are not closed; --closed lists only the closed ones, --all lists every change.

id.description: A layr id in UUID form.

status.description: The status of the change: 'merged' when its newest version is in the history of the line main or a queue entry merged it, else 'closed' after 'layr change close' (until 'layr change reopen'), else 'open'.

closed.description: Who closed the change, when and why. Present only when the status is 'closed'.

machine.description: The id of the machine that recorded the close.

time.description: When the change was closed, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

reason.description: The reason from 'layr change close -m'. Absent without one.

actor.description: The user who recorded an operation on its machine.

uid.description: The user id (uid) on the machine of the record.

name.description: The user name on the machine of the record, or 'person:<login>' for a person key.

session.description: The LAYR_SESSION label of the process. Free text. Absent when it was not set.

change.description: One change, described by its newest version.

change_id.description: The id of the change. 'layr change show <change_id>' shows it.

number.description: The number of the change (#12 in the text output; 'layr change show 12' finds it). The numbering machine of the project gives the numbers. Null until it has given one.

title.description: The title that 'layr change edit --title' set, else the first line of the message of the newest version.

description.description: The description that 'layr change edit --description' set, else the rest of the message of the newest version after its first line. Null when that is empty.

line.description: The id of the line that made the newest version. Null when the state names no line.

line_name.description: The current name of 'line'. A deleted line keeps its last name. Null when 'line' is null or the project has no record of the line.

versions.description: The number of versions of the change.

state.description: The id of the state of the newest version.

message.description: The full message of the newest version.
